inputs.original_text: South African actress Terry Pheto has once again been drawn into controversy after new details emerged in Parliament linking her to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission (NLC). The revelations were presented during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. The session [...] The post Terry Pheto Linked To R20.56 Million NLC Funding Scandal In SIU Probe appeared first on SurgeZirc SA .
inputs.modified_text: They’re putting Terry Pheto and the alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal in the spotlight, but that may be deliberate: give the public one recognizable person to focus on while the institutions involved control what is said and what remains hidden. The claims surfaced at the Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. A briefing and an SIU probe don’t reveal the whole story, and the more this is framed as being about one person, the more I’d ask whose interests that serves.
